# Geekflare

> Geekflare is a collaborative AI workspace and developer API platform unifying access to 40+ LLM models with powerful web scraping, data extraction, and business automation tools.

Geekflare provides both a unified AI platform (supporting OpenAI, Google, Anthropic models) and a comprehensive API suite for web scraping, screenshots, and RAG context extraction. The platform serves developers, teams, and businesses seeking cost-effective AI collaboration and data extraction solutions.

## Key Topics

- Geekflare AI
- Geekflare API
- Geekflare Connect
- Multi-model LLM access
- Web scraping API
- RAG pipeline
- Team collaboration
- BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)
- Data extraction
- Headless browser
- ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini
- Cost reduction
- API documentation
- AI workspace

## Core Products

- [Geekflare - Collaborative AI Workspace & Developer APIs](https://geekflare.com): Geekflare homepage: AI workspace with 40+ models, APIs for search & scraping
- [Geekflare AI | Unify Your Business AI Strategy](https://geekflare.com/ai): Unified platform for OpenAI, Google, Anthropic models with team collaboration features
- [Geekflare Connect | BYOK AI Workspace for Teams](https://geekflare.com/ai/connect): BYOK platform for team AI collaboration and cost reduction
- [Geekflare API - Scrape, Screenshot & Extract RAG Context](https://geekflare.com/api): Web scraping, screenshots, and RAG context extraction for developers
- [Geekflare Tools for Business Growth](https://geekflare.com/tools): Free suite for website audit, invoicing, and business productivity

## API Reference & Documentation

- [Geekflare API Docs - Geekflare](https://docs.geekflare.com/api): REST API documentation: authentication, rate limits, and integration guides
- [Geekflare AI Docs - Geekflare](https://docs.geekflare.com/ai): AI platform documentation: getting started, system requirements, setup
- [Web Scraping API - Extract HTML, Markdown & LLM Data](https://geekflare.com/api/webscraping): Web scraping API with code examples, pricing, and data extraction capabilities
- [Geekflare API Collection | Scraping, Screenshots, Security & SEO APIs](https://geekflare.com/api/collection): Complete API collection: web scraping, screenshots, DNS, security tools
